title: Procreate Christmas Village Creator

fullDescription:
Create your own magical Christmas village maps in Procreate with this festive Isometric Map Creator Brush Set. Build snowy winter towns, Santa’s village scenes, Christmas markets, fantasy maps, illustrated town layouts and holiday artwork using coordinated isometric buildings, characters and decorations.
Designed with a consistent isometric perspective, the elements can be mixed and matched easily to create large Christmas scenes like the examples shown in the listing.

WHAT’S INCLUDED
This Christmas-themed collection features a variety of hand-drawn isometric elements, including:
Santa’s Workshop
Elf Workshops & Elf Houses
Christmas & Winter Houses
Candy Factory
Coffee Shop
Christmas Tree Shop
Churches
Christmas Clock Towers
Festive Town Squares
Christmas Trees & Decorations
Reindeer Stalls & Petting Areas
Reindeer
Santa’s Sleigh & Reindeer Teams
Santa Claus
Male & Female Elves
Snow-covered buildings
Market/Fair structures
Additional festive village elements
All assets are designed to work together so you can quickly assemble your own Santa village, North Pole town, Christmas market or winter fantasy map.

PERFECT FOR
Christmas village illustrations, fantasy maps, tabletop/RPG maps, children’s illustrations, coloring projects, holiday planners, printable artwork, digital scrapbooking, storybook scenes and festive world-building.

NOTE! You will need a Procreate app and an iPad to use these Stamp Brushes, they will not work in Photoshop or any other application.
